# pyelftools 0.33 (vendored, unmodified)
- Source: PyPI wheel `pyelftools-0.33-py3-none-any.whl`, sha256 `f215ad5f47d3f1373a21496a6c9e0707c622840d0622f23ff7ce08678b020036`; only the `elftools/` package and `LICENSE` are kept.
- License: public domain (see `LICENSE`).
- Requires Python >= 3.10 (`Requires-Python` in the wheel metadata).
- Used by `engine/debugger/linetable.py` to read DWARF line rows (with columns and discriminators). Not edited; to upgrade, replace the directory with a newer wheel's `elftools/` and update this file.
- Not covered by `npm run typecheck` (TypeScript only); there is no linter or formatter in this repo.
